summary: Iteration 17 - Testing Shopify and Zoho Dashboard Integrations. All 32 backend tests passed (100%). All 6 dashboards (GA4, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Sheets, Shopify, Zoho) render correctly on Data Sources tab. Zoho Books/CRM toggle works. API_CONTRACTS.md documents all 7 endpoints.
critical_code_review_comments: Shopify routes correctly return sample data with store_name, summary, daily_performance, top_products, recent_orders, traffic_sources
Zoho routes correctly return sample data for both Books (module='books') and CRM (module='crm')
All endpoints require authentication (return 401/403 without token)
is_sample_data flag is correctly set to true for all sample data responses
API_CONTRACTS.md properly documents all 7 dashboard endpoints with exact JSON schemas
ShopifyDashboard.jsx renders KPI cards, charts (Revenue Trend, Traffic Sources, Visitors & Conversion, Daily Orders), and tables (Top Products, Recent Orders)

ZohoDashboard.jsx renders Books view (Income vs Expenses, Expense Breakdown, Profit Trend, Invoices table) and CRM view (Sales Pipeline, Lead Sources, Monthly Deals, Recent Deals table) with working toggle
GoogleAnalyticsDashboard.jsx fix confirmed - daily_chart fallback (line 123: const daily_chart = data.daily_chart || data.daily_metrics || []) prevents crash
seed_data_creation: None - all endpoints return sample data by design
